description: The promise of the video in big text during the first 1-3 s (not the caption of what is said). Words fade up one by one, then the words wrapped in *stars* get an accent marker sweeping in behind them. 2-6 words, at most 2 lines ('|' = new line). Sits in the upper third, clear of the captions.

size.doc: font size as a fraction of frame width (shrinks to fit)
